{"type":"stream_event","event":{"type":"content_block_delta","index":1,"delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"ARTIFACT ==="}},"session_id":"daf409ae-bc34-4b77-abae-b5e98578d49e","parent_tool_use_id":null,"uuid":"ea519f14-8b91-4987-9611-8cd44f67fca6","api_message_id":"msg_011CgR9YdmJzt5fwKmhroSSE"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgR9YdmJzt5fwKmhroSSE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT ANALYSIS.md ===\n# Blueprint Analysis: LayersTesting\n\n## Commander Expectations\n\n- assert the product is a command-line ledger that runs as an executable named `ledger` at the application root\n- assert every command either completes in full or changes nothing\n- assert account balances, category totals, and monthly totals are computed from stored ledger data\n- assert the ledger passes the supplied LayersTesting grader with every check passing\n- assert amounts are stored as integer cents and written with exactly two decimal places\n\n## Crew\n\n| Crew | Charge |\n|---|---|\n| Commander | Defines intent and decides what done means. |\n| Team Lead | Confirms epic completeness and stakeholder expectations. |\n| Planning Crew | Authors atomic specifications and the ordered Manifest. |\n| Shipyard Crew | Builds the tickets without synchronous Commander access. |\n\n## Story List\n\n### Feature: Database Setup\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| DBSETUP-001 | Initialize an empty ledger | `ledger init` prepares the accounts, categories, and transactions tables, writes nothing, exits 0, and removes existing ledger rows when rerun |\n| DBSETUP-002 | Resolve the database location | DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db; optional sqlite:// prefix; postgres:// and postgresql:// values are classed as PostgreSQL DSNs |\n| DBSETUP-003 | Report operational database failures | An unreachable database, missing tables, or an unreadable file exits 1 with one stderr line and no stdout |\n\n### Feature: Data Loading\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| LOAD-001 | Load accounts from CSV | Header must equal account,name; all rows are stored or none; writes table,loaded and accounts,N; duplicate codes exit 3 |\n| LOAD-002 | Load categories from CSV | Header must equal category,description; all rows are stored or none; writes table,loaded and categories,N; duplicate codes exit 3 |\n| LOAD-003 | Load transactions from CSV | Header must equal the transaction columns; txn_id kept from file; unknown accounts or categories, duplicate ids, and any balance below zero exit 3 with nothing stored |\n| LOAD-004 | Count rows per table | `ledger count` writes table,rows then accounts, categories, and transactions rows in that order |\n\n### Feature: Accounts\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| ACCT-001 | Add an account | `account add` stores the account and returns its row with 0 transactions and balance 0.00; duplicate code exits 3 |\n| ACCT-002 | Get an account | `account get` returns the current row with transaction count and balance; absent code exits 4 |\n| ACCT-003 | Rename an account | `account rename` changes the name only and returns the updated row; absent code exits 4 |\n| ACCT-004 | Delete an account | `account delete` removes an account with no transactions and writes deleted and the code; an account with transactions exits 3; absent code exits 4 |\n\n### Feature: Transactions\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| TXN-001 | Post a transaction | `txn post` assigns the next txn_id, validates account, category, amount, date, and memo, stores the row, and returns it |\n| TXN-002 | Get a transaction | `txn get` returns the stored row for the id; absent id exits 4 |\n| TXN-003 | Amend a transaction amount | `txn amend` changes only the amount and returns the updated row; absent id exits 4 |\n| TXN-004 | Delete a transaction | `txn delete` removes the row and writes deleted and the id; absent id exits 4 |\n\n### Feature: Transfers\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| XFER-001 | Record a paired transfer | `transfer` stores two TRANSFER rows, -amount on the source and +amount on the destination, with consecutive ids and the specified memos, and returns both rows |\n| XFER-002 | Reject invalid transfers | Zero or negative amounts, identical accounts, and unknown accounts exit 3; a transfer leaving the source below zero exits 3; neither leg is stored |\n\n### Feature: Reports\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| RPT-001 | Balances report | `report balances` lists each account by code with its transaction count and balance, then a TOTAL row, all computed from stored rows |\n| RPT-002 | Categories report | `report categories` lists every category by code, including empty ones, with inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row |\n| RPT-003 | Monthly report | `report monthly` lists each YYYY-MM that has transactions in ascending order with inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row |\n\n### Feature: Input Validation\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| VAL-001 | Validate codes, names, descriptions, and memos | Codes are 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9; names and descriptions 1 to 40 characters; memos 0 to 60; none contains a comma or newline; violations exit 3 |\n| VAL-002 | Validate amounts | Input matches an optional minus sign, digits, and at most two decimal places; amounts equal to zero are rejected; violations exit 3 |\n| VAL-003 | Validate dates | Dates must be real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates such as 2026-02-30 exit 3 |\n\n### Feature: Ledger Integrity\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| INT-001 | Rejected commands change nothing | Every write command checks all inputs and rules before its first write; a rejected load, account change, transaction change, or transfer stores no partial rows |\n| INT-002 | No negative balances | Any load, post, amend, delete, or transfer that leaves an account balance below zero exits 3 and preserves prior balances |\n\n### Feature: Command-Line Interface\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| CLI-001 | Provide the ledger executable | An executable named ledger exists at the application root; an unknown command or report, or a wrong argument count, exits 2 with one stderr line naming the expected form |\n| CLI-002 | Write CSV output | Successful output has one header, comma-separated rows, no quoting, no trailing spaces, and \\n line endings; amounts show two decimals, a leading minus when negative, and no separators; failures write nothing to stdout |\n\n### Feature: Test Suite\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| TEST-001 | Provide the application test runner | bin/test.sh, POSIX-compatible, runs the application's pytest suite from the application root and exits 0 only when every test passes; the suite covers each command, exit code, and rule against a temporary database |\n\n### Feature: Acceptance\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| ACCEPT-001 | Pass the supplied LayersTesting grader | `sh sources/run.sh` exits 0 with every check passing; this terminal story gates on every implementation story |\n\n## Surfaced Acceptance Criteria\n\nThe analyze step has surfaced these acceptance criteria for `drydock plan` to fold into the\nrelevant story's typed specification. \"None.\" if the Gap Checklist surfaced no story-scoped items.\n\n| ID | Story ID | Criterion |\n|---|---|---|\n| AC-001 | CLI-001 | A usage error writes exactly one line to standard error that shows the expected form of the failing command, so every command and sub-verb has its help text. |\n| AC-002 | LOAD-001 | A CSV row whose field count differs from the header is rejected with exit 3 and stores no rows from that file. |\n| AC-003 | TXN-002 | A transaction id that is not a positive integer is rejected with exit 3 and is not reported as absent. |\n| AC-004 | ACCT-004 | An account whose transactions have all been deleted may be deleted. |\n| AC-005 | RPT-001 | With no accounts, `report balances` writes the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`. |\n| AC-006 | RPT-002 | With no transactions, `report categories` writes every category with 0 transactions and 0.00 for inflow, outflow, and net, followed by `TOTAL,,0,0.00,0.00,0.00`. |\n| AC-007 | RPT-003 | With no transactions, `report monthly` writes the header and `TOTAL,0,0.00,0.00,0.00` with no month rows. |\n| AC-008 | INT-001 | Two commands running concurrently against the same database each complete in full or change nothing, and no partial rows are visible to either. |\n| AC-009 | DBSETUP-002 | An empty DATABASE_URL is treated as unset, so resolution falls through to DATABASE_PATH and then data/app.db. |\n\n## Relationship Model\n\nInfer cross-file delivery relationships from the imported source material. Every write command validates all\nof its inputs and balance rules before its first write.\n\nPersistence is three relational tables (accounts, categories, transactions) accessed only through the\nshipped persistence library. BEGIN ARTIFACT ANALYSIS.md ===\n# Blueprint Analysis: LayersTesting\n\n## Commander Expectations\n\n- assert the product is a command-line ledger that runs as an executable named `ledger` at the application root\n- assert every command either completes in full or changes nothing\n- assert account balances, category totals, and monthly totals are computed from stored ledger data\n- assert the ledger passes the supplied LayersTesting grader with every check passing\n- assert amounts are stored as integer cents and written with exactly two decimal places\n\n## Crew\n\n| Crew | Charge |\n|---|---|\n| Commander | Defines intent and decides what done means. |\n| Team Lead | Confirms epic completeness and stakeholder expectations. |\n| Planning Crew | Authors atomic specifications and the ordered Manifest. |\n| Shipyard Crew | Builds the tickets without synchronous Commander access. |\n\n## Story List\n\n### Feature: Database Setup\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| DBSETUP-001 | Initialize an empty ledger | `ledger init` prepares the accounts, categories, and transactions tables, writes nothing, exits 0, and removes existing ledger rows when rerun |\n| DBSETUP-002 | Resolve the database location | DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db; optional sqlite:// prefix; postgres:// and postgresql:// values are classed as PostgreSQL DSNs |\n| DBSETUP-003 | Report operational database failures | An unreachable database, missing tables, or an unreadable file exits 1 with one stderr line and no stdout |\n\n### Feature: Data Loading\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| LOAD-001 | Load accounts from CSV | Header must equal account,name; all rows are stored or none; writes table,loaded and accounts,N; duplicate codes exit 3 |\n| LOAD-002 | Load categories from CSV | Header must equal category,description; all rows are stored or none; writes table,loaded and categories,N; duplicate codes exit 3 |\n| LOAD-003 | Load transactions from CSV | Header must equal the transaction columns; txn_id kept from file; unknown accounts or categories, duplicate ids, and any balance below zero exit 3 with nothing stored |\n| LOAD-004 | Count rows per table | `ledger count` writes table,rows then accounts, categories, and transactions rows in that order |\n\n### Feature: Accounts\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| ACCT-001 | Add an account | `account add` stores the account and returns its row with 0 transactions and balance 0.00; duplicate code exits 3 |\n| ACCT-002 | Get an account | `account get` returns the current row with transaction count and balance; absent code exits 4 |\n| ACCT-003 | Rename an account | `account rename` changes the name only and returns the updated row; absent code exits 4 |\n| ACCT-004 | Delete an account | `account delete` removes an account with no transactions and writes deleted and the code; an account with transactions exits 3; absent code exits 4 |\n\n### Feature: Transactions\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| TXN-001 | Post a transaction | `txn post` assigns the next txn_id, validates account, category, amount, date, and memo, stores the row, and returns it |\n| TXN-002 | Get a transaction | `txn get` returns the stored row for the id; absent id exits 4 |\n| TXN-003 | Amend a transaction amount | `txn amend` changes only the amount and returns the updated row; absent id exits 4 |\n| TXN-004 | Delete a transaction | `txn delete` removes the row and writes deleted and the id; absent id exits 4 |\n\n### Feature: Transfers\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| XFER-001 | Record a paired transfer | `transfer` stores two TRANSFER rows, -amount on the source and +amount on the destination, with consecutive ids and the specified memos, and returns both rows |\n| XFER-002 | Reject invalid transfers | Zero or negative amounts, identical accounts, and unknown accounts exit 3; a transfer leaving the source below zero exits 3; neither leg is stored |\n\n### Feature: Reports\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| RPT-001 | Balances report | `report balances` lists each account by code with its transaction count and balance, then a TOTAL row, all computed from stored rows |\n| RPT-002 | Categories report | `report categories` lists every category by code, including empty ones, with inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row |\n| RPT-003 | Monthly report | `report monthly` lists each YYYY-MM that has transactions in ascending order with inflow, outflow, and net, then a TOTAL row |\n\n### Feature: Input Validation\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| VAL-001 | Validate codes, names, descriptions, and memos | Codes are 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9; names and descriptions 1 to 40 characters; memos 0 to 60; none contains a comma or newline; violations exit 3 |\n| VAL-002 | Validate amounts | Input matches an optional minus sign, digits, and at most two decimal places; amounts equal to zero are rejected; violations exit 3 |\n| VAL-003 | Validate dates | Dates must be real calendar dates written YYYY-MM-DD; invalid dates such as 2026-02-30 exit 3 |\n\n### Feature: Ledger Integrity\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| INT-001 | Rejected commands change nothing | Every write command checks all inputs and rules before its first write; a rejected load, account change, transaction change, or transfer stores no partial rows |\n| INT-002 | No negative balances | Any load, post, amend, delete, or transfer that leaves an account balance below zero exits 3 and preserves prior balances |\n\n### Feature: Command-Line Interface\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| CLI-001 | Provide the ledger executable | An executable named ledger exists at the application root; an unknown command or report, or a wrong argument count, exits 2 with one stderr line naming the expected form |\n| CLI-002 | Write CSV output | Successful output has one header, comma-separated rows, no quoting, no trailing spaces, and \\n line endings; amounts show two decimals, a leading minus when negative, and no separators; failures write nothing to stdout |\n\n### Feature: Test Suite\n\n| ID | Story | High-level AC |\n|---|---|---|\n| TEST-001 | Provide the application test runner | bin/test.sh,
